conventions.secondary: A second colour band is a stripe of tape, used where one colour has run out within a position.
conventions.spare: A spare is a " SP" suffix on the label plus PINK, same type as its primary. It is a label, not a boolean flag, because electricians read labels off physical tape. B1/B1 SP, MA/MA SP, C1-C9 and their SPs.

name: Colour tokens
note: Rule 2 of the data model: colours are stored as token names and resolved to hex at render. Pre-Pro stored cable colour as a name and location colour as raw hex from an older palette generation, so re-imported BMW data silently repainted — its archived import carries #ef4444 for RED while the live palette's RED is #ff2020. Version this table; never store a hex on a record.
source: COLORS in Pre-Pro Loom Builder, palette generation 2 (current)
